const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "Test proxy connectivity and node version",
  command: `$env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7897'
node -v
Write-Output '--- proxy test ---'
curl -s -o NUL -w "sogou:%{http_code} " -x http://127.0.0.1:7897 -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/131.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" --max-time 20 "https://weixin.sogou.com/"
curl -s -o NUL -w "qingtuan:%{http_code} " -x http://127.0.0.1:7897 -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/131.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" --max-time 20 "https://www.qingtuanshe.com/"
curl -s -o NUL -w "pinggu:%{http_code} " -x http://127.0.0.1:7897 -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/131.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" --max-time 20 "http://bbs.pinggu.org/"
curl -s -o NUL -w "v2ex:%{http_code} " -x http://127.0.0.1:7897 -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" --max-time 20 "https://www.v2ex.com/"
Write-Output ''`,
  timeoutMs: 120000,
  workdir: "D:\\GitHub\\My-second-brain\\50-知识\\AI工具\\_scripts"
});
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r));
tool_input.description: Test proxy reachability of target sites
